purpose: Increase team-head training diversity from nine to nineteen games; retain frozen v2 dead probabilities/decoder
model: Original stage-one HGB parameters, 108 original+observed-context features, team-swap symmetry, seed0, no early stopping
evaluation: Leave-one-entire-game-out across all 19 training games; all augmentations of the test game excluded. Original v2 baseline nested exclusions retained. Fresh European games never train weights.
development_gate: Weighted spellF1 gain >= .005; no mean loss worse than .005 in any of the five reported cohorts, including known stress. Ties prefer lower new-head weight.
fresh_reference: Automatic H/A only where source ownership is known. Unknown is X, never synthetic D. Periods derive independently of ownership. Conditional team macroF1 primary; not a full H/A/D score.
fresh_gate: One frozen candidate only. Conditional team macroF1 gain >=.005, descriptive paired 95% lower bound >0, at least7/9 wins. Do not pick a runner-up after fresh scores.
adoption: Both development and fresh gates must pass; otherwise keep v2. Fresh test only if development passes. All earlier known-data selection is disclosed.
competition_inputs: No competition tracking, video, tagging, public or private GT used in this selection process
